name: Mélykút (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Mélykút (a green and white shield with a brown ox at a well, a wheel and the Hungarian tricolour, within a yellow frame inscribed MÉLYKÚT 1716) above the name MÉLYKÚT in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mélykút arms in a yellow frame
